sloka: वारणाभिः च हरिभिर् ययौ परिव्Rतस् तदा ।तम् यान्तम् अनुयाति स्म महती हरि वाहिनी ॥६-४-२५॥।।
transliteration: vāraṇābhiḥ ca haribhir yayau parivRtas tadā ।tam yāntam anuyāti sma mahatī hari vāhinī ॥6-4-25॥।।

translations.english: While Rama was walking the great army of vanaras controlled by Sugriva followed him with great delight.
